# Trigger Mask

**Version 1.2** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2231939373) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=trigger-mask&expanded=true)

Nobody cared who I was before I put on the mask.

Put a mask on any character in the world and leave it there. The face
disappears entirely, and depending on which mask you choose, so does anyone's
willingness to cross you.

---

## Four masks

| Mask | What it does |
|---|---|
| **The Mask** | Pure disguise. The face vanishes, nothing else changes. |
| **Bandaged Face** | The same total disguise in linen. Less executioner, more something that should see a physician. |
| **The Dread Mask** | Disguise, a solid floor under your **Dread**, fear that gathers on its own and is slow to fade, and a trickle of prestige from it. |
| **The Mask of Extreme Dread** | All of that, enormously amplified, and fear that pays. See below. |

A character wears one mask at a time. Take it off and you can put a different
one on.

## Fear that pays for itself

When this mod was first written, Dread was mostly a number that made vassals
think twice. The game has since built an entire economy around it, and the two
dread masks now draw on that.

**The Mask of Extreme Dread** turns fear into:

- **Money and soldiers.** Terrified vassals hand over noticeably more tax
  and far larger levies.
- **Better knights.** Your knights fight harder the more feared you are.
- **Prestige.** Simply being dreadful earns it, every month.
- **Freedom to be cruel.** Tyranny washes off twice as quickly.

None of the original numbers were reduced. This is all on top of what the mask
already did.

## How to use it

Right-click any character, choose **Open Mask Menu**, and all four mask
options appear in the interaction list. Close the menu again when you are
finished so it is not cluttering every right-click.

This works on yourself too -- right-click your own portrait.

Either way it applies instantly, and **Remove the Mask** always takes it
back off.

## What actually changes

- A **face mask** covers the character entirely
- The **beard disappears** underneath it
- The **facial features** beneath are smoothed flat, so nothing pushes
  through the mask
- **Dread** changes, on the two dread masks

Unlike the appearance, the Dread is real. It feeds the same system that makes
vassals afraid to rebel and lets you intimidate people into obedience, so the
two dread masks are genuinely gameplay cheats and not just a look. The Mask and
the Bandaged Face are pure appearance.

## Things to know

- **Fully reversible**, at any time, with no cooldown.
- **Works on anyone**, not just your own dynasty. Mask your whole court if
  you like.
- The masks do **not** pass to children.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.19 "Scribe"**.
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod will disable achievements, as
  gameplay mods do.
- **Other mods:** it adds four traits and seven interactions, and overwrites no base game file. Other mods that add headgear to
  the same slot may fight over the result.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add mid-game. Remove the mod and masked
  characters revert to their own faces.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written;
the other eight currently show the English wording. Translations are welcome.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `trigger-mask-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=trigger-mask&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
